results.content: Having secured the nomination, Democrat **David Jolly** is getting a boost from the **Democratic Governors Association**, which is pushing polling showing him with a margin-of-error edge over Republican **Byron Donalds**, suggesting that 2026 will look much more like 2018 than Gov. The pollsters show that 18% of Republicans say they will crossover to vote for Jolly, compared to just 7% of Democrats open to backing Donalds. The pollsters say that Donalds’ position on data centers and his wife and his “profiting from a network of charter schools they founded while student achievement lagged” raise major doubts with nearly 2/3 of voters at large, and 3/4 of independents.
